grass:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable seamless square grass ground texture for a top-down cozy farming RPG, source for modular terrain.
Input images: Image 1 is a style and palette reference only, not an edit target; retain the compatible hand-painted fantasy look but make the ground greener and a little more lively.
Primary request: One square, seamless, edge-to-edge spring meadow grass material. Quiet fresh moss and sage greens, restrained painterly small grass strokes, occasional tiny clover leaves, subtle larger soft patches in value. Approximately 85 percent calm ground and 15 percent sparse readable detail. Color should be fresh grassy green around #7F9B58 rather than grey or beige.
Composition: Flat orthographic ground seen directly from above, evenly lit, no horizon, no perspective, homogeneous detail scale everywhere. Seamless opposite edges; no central focal composition. High-resolution square 1024 by 1024.
Constraints: A single opaque tile filling the entire image. No margin, no sheet, no frame, no labels, no buildings, no trees, no isolated large tufts, no flowers, no stones, no cast shadows, no vignette, no directional lighting gradient.
Avoid: noisy photographic texture, thick outlines, large coarse pixel blocks, checkerboard, highly saturated lime green, dense decorative pattern. Simple clean game material readable at small scale.
path:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable seamless square packed-earth footpath material for a top-down cozy farming RPG.
Input images: Image 1 is a style and palette reference only; make ground compatible with its existing modular houses and vegetation.
Primary request: One square, seamless, edge-to-edge compacted warm ochre earth material, the worn smooth middle of a village walking path. Muted warm beige around #B59A68 with broad restrained hand-painted tones, a few small rounded grey-brown pebbles, tiny sandy specks and very subtle scuffs. Mostly calm surface.
Composition: Flat orthographic ground seen directly from above, evenly lit. Homogeneous material, seamless opposite edges, no central focal composition. High-resolution square 1024 by 1024.
Constraints: Full opaque earth over the entire image; do not draw a whole road, path outline, grass border or scene. The game will form the path edges and junctions separately. No margin, no grid, no labels, no large rocks, no plants, no footprints, no cast shadows, no vignette.
Avoid: photographic gravel, dense crack texture, extreme contrast, large coarse pixels, artificial paving blocks. Match a simple clean illustrated farming-game material.
